annotations.title: Skill Check (is this agent skill safe to install?)

description: Skill Check: scans an OpenClaw / ClawHub, Claude Code or Codex skill (SKILL.md and its scripts) before you install it, for the patterns used by the 2026 ClawHub malware skills: paste-in-Terminal set-up steps, download-and-run, password-protected archives, macOS quarantine bypass, fake password dialogs, Keychain, browser, wallet and agent-key theft, reverse shells, hidden instructions and leaked secrets. Use before installing or enabling any agent skill you did not write: a ClawHub skill (pass its link or slug), a GitHub skill folder or repo, a raw SKILL.md URL, or pasted text / files[]. Fetches every text file of the skill (up to 30) and lists binaries it can't read. Returns verdict (safe, careful, dont_install), score 0-100 (higher is riskier), name and description from SKILL.md, findings[] {file, rule, severity, message, evidence, line}, counts {high, medium, low}, files[], skipped[], urls[], source {type clawhub/github/url/pasted, ref, version, clawhubFlag} and summary. Rules, not a model; nothing is stored. Not charged when the skill can't be fetched. Price: $0.005 per call from Exepal credit; not charged if the call fails. Includes free daily calls.

files.description: Instead of url: up to 30 files {path, text} of the skill

path.description: File path inside the skill, e.g. SKILL.md or scripts/setup.sh
With text: its file name (default SKILL.md)

text.description: Instead of url: the SKILL.md content (up to 300,000 characters)

url.description: A ClawHub skill link or slug (clawhub.ai/owner/skill), a GitHub link to a skill folder or repo, or a raw SKILL.md URL

name: skill_check

kind.description: skill-md, script, doc, config or other

line.description: 0 when not tied to a line

clawhubFlag.description: ClawHub's own moderation note when the skill is flagged there
